# Vishwaclaudema

> Start building with Claude the right way, and find the tools worth having.

## Start a project
Each starter kit is a one-paste setup prompt for Claude Code, the tools worth installing (each safety-scanned and reviewed), and a first week.
- [Start a website or web app](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/start/website/): Sites and web apps (Next.js, React, Astro and the like).
- [Start an app that uses Claude](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/start/ai-feature/): Anything that sends prompts to Claude through the API or an SDK.
- [Start a mobile app](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/start/mobile/): Expo, React Native or Swift apps.
- [Start an automation](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/start/automation/): Scripts, crons, bots and anything that should run without you.
- [Start a writing or documents project](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/start/writing/): Reports, proposals, research and decks, mostly outside code.
- [The foundation](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/start/foundation/): the habits and tools every kit installs, how to use them, how to write CLAUDE.md, and a prompt that sets them up in any project.

## Improve a project you already have
- [Tidy your Claude setup](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/improve/setup/): Any project you already work on with Claude.
- [Add a feature](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/improve/feature/): A project that works, and a new thing you want it to do.
- [Make it look better](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/improve/design/): A site or app that works but looks generic or dated.
- [Sharper words](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/improve/copy/): Headlines, landing pages and calls to action that don't land.
- [Get found](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/improve/seo/): A public site that search engines and AI answers should cite.
- [Faster and accessible](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/improve/speed/): Slow pages, poor phone scores, or people who can't use the site with a keyboard or screen reader.
- [Add a safety net](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/improve/tests/): A project where changes keep breaking things.
- [Check before launch](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/improve/security/): Anything that handles sign-ins, personal data or payments.

## Find tools
- [Find tools](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/discover/): search 3,593 Claude skills, plugins and MCP servers from Anthropic's catalogues, skills.sh, GitHub and the MCP registry, with an install prompt for each.
- [Full index as JSON](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/data/tools.json): name, kind, repo, description, installs, stars, growth, tasks, flags, and the pinned install command for vetted tools.
